text: The CAT-DDO 4 offers a contingent credit line of US$500 million, which can be rapidly accessed upon the declaration of a State of Calamity or State of Public Health Emergency. It features a 3-year drawdown period, renewable up to 15 years, and a revolving feature allowing re-withdrawal of repaid amounts. The program requires the Philippines to maintain a satisfactory disaster and public health risk management program, monitored by the World Bank.

metadata.solution_name: Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4)
